redfin.remarks: Rare 2003 reconstructed single-level home in desirable Temple City. This beautifully designed 3,149 sq. ft. residence features 6 spacious bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, including 3 en-suite bedrooms for enhanced comfort and privacy, along with a 2-car garage and additional driveway parking for two cars. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home offers dual kitchens (Western and Chinese) with a large center island , granite countertops , new stove, and new kitchen cabinetry - ideal for hosting gatherings or multi-generational living. Soaring 12-foot-high ceilings and an open concept floor plan create a bright and airy atmosphere, while abundant natural light highlights the home’s modern and elegant design. Located within the highly sought after Temple City Unified School District, this exceptional property offers space, functionality, and convenience, with a prime location near supermarkets, dining, and easy freeway access.
